guide_text: Section-shell contract records The section shells for backend_validation , diagnostics , documentation , embedding , language_surface and semantic_exports describe discovery and field presence. Their owners are respectively BackendValidationContract , DiagnosticsContract , DocumentationContract , EmbeddingContract , LanguageSurfaceContract and SemanticExportsContract , all under FSM::Support . Read section_contract , or surface_contract for language_surface . Other records have separate owners and shapes. These shells publish numeric schema_version , status: bounded_public , their contract_source , and report_source: FSM::Support::CapabilityManifest . The status marks this bounded contract; it does not make every described child public, available or fully stable. entrypoints.cli is the manifest command string, cli_aliases is an array of alias strings, and in_process is an array of manifest/section-builder examples. They do not invoke those APIs or add MCP operations. guidance is an array of scope and deliberate-widening advice. Use named map members; these shells promise no positional priority for lists. Field or family Interpretation public_top_level_presence_keys Required field-name strings for the parent section. This does not enumerate the shell record itself or close deeper objects. nested_contract_keys , nested_contract_source_map Where present, child-name list and child-name to dedicated owner-namespace map. Follow each owner for the described surface. nested_presence_key_map Where present, child-name to field-name-array map. Its subject depends on the child contract, as listed below. *_contract_advertised , nested_contracts_advertised Boolean confirmation that the named contracts are advertised. This grants no execution capability. full_*_section_stable , full_language_surface_stable Boolean false keeps the complete section outside a whole-tree stability promise. The named bounded families still apply. Do not validate every nested list against the child metadata object. For example, backend_validation.section_contract.nested_presence_key_map.systemverilog_external contains ok , source_file , top_module , and steps : success-result fields of external validation, not fields of its capability advertisement. Section and child Subject of the nested presence family backend_validation.systemverilog_external Successful external-validation result. diagnostics.stable_code_registry Registry sibling fields registry_source , stable_codes , stable_code_registry in the diagnostics section. diagnostics.check_json Common check-report envelope; success/failure extensions retain their dedicated contract. semantic_exports.normalized_semantic_json Common normalized semantic-report envelope; deeper source/IR content remains separately scoped. embedding.composition_report Sanitized composition-report fragment. Raw report objects are not JSON interchange payloads. embedding.hdl_generator_result Sorted known-key union of common presence, direct-root and composition-root key families. It does not require every union member on every result. embedding.serializable_generation_result_snapshot Generation-result snapshot output, rather than its contract record. Other embedding map children Their advertised facade, ISF-interface, plan/report, typed-extension or debug contract records . A contract describing debug state does not make a live filehandle serializable. language_surface map children First-level metadata objects for the named language family or specialized HIAL/VIAL surface. Their availability and public/private status remain distinct. In diagnostics, scalar_string_keys names registry_source , list_keys names stable_codes , and stable_code_entry_presence_keys names fields of each code record. presence_key_family_map repeats those same-named lists. stable_code_family_values lists the bounded family labels; it is a value enum, not a field-name list. Code definitions remain with the diagnostic registry. In documentation, path_list_keys names human_contract and downstream_alignment . path_contract promises repository-relative tracked Markdown paths and explicitly sets exact_path_lists_frozen: false . path_list_contract_map associates each named list with those rules; it does not contain document text or freeze the file membership. This shell has no nested_contract_source_map or nested_presence_key_map . In the language shell, each NAME_presence_keys list describes the correspondingly named child and equals nested_presence_key_map.NAME : strict_mode , file_surfaces , hial_vial_bridge , vial_execution , vial_native_uvm_emission , vial_vhdl_emission , vial_tooling , default_mode_compatibility , assignments , system_contracts , expressions , declarations , and composition . The extra file_surface_entry_presence_keys list describes each entry under file_surfaces.entries and equals file_surfaces.entry_presence_keys . It does not describe the file-surfaces container. This shell publishes presence families without a nested_contract_source_map ; use the top-level owner and the specialized child contracts rather than inventing one. This guide interprets the shell fields and their map subjects. The dedicated report, embedding, language and VIAL references own deeper payload meanings, argument contracts and execution limits. Presence, version and advertising flags alone do not establish complete operating-reference coverage.
scope: Native built HTML guide and table/content checks only; no browser/whole-manual visual qualification.
